title: State relabeling commutes with one oracle step
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\Sigma$ be an alphabet, let $S,S'$ be state sets, let $x$ be a word over $\Sigma$, let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes and states $S$, and let $e\colon S\simeq S'$ be a bijection. For every oracle language $O$ over $\Sigma$ and configuration $c$ on input $x$, one step of the relabeled machine from the relabeling of $c$ equals the relabeling of the configuration reached by one step of $M$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes and states $S$
